medial_oa.quote: Stanjena femoralna i tibijalna hrskavica, naglašenije u lateralnom dijelu zgloba

lateral_oa.quote: gdje se mjestimično vidi povišenje signala čitave debljine femoralne hrskavice /hondromalacija III stupnja/ te zona denudacije tibije uz već opisan koštani edem.

pf_oa.quote: Na prijelazu lateralne i medijalne fasete patele povišen intenzitet signala hrskavice do polovice debljine.

effusion.quote: Veća količina izljeva femoropatelarno, suprapatelarno i u lateralnom recesusu.

bakers_cyst.quote: Manja poplitealna cista unutar koje se izdvajaju sitni fragmenti (slobodna osteohondralna tijela?).

contusion.quote: Zona koštanog edema prednjeg i srednjeg dijela lateralnog kondila tibije.

fracture.quote: Ne vidi se frakture.

acl.quote: Kruisbanden en laterale banden intact.

mcl.quote: Kruisbanden en laterale banden intact.

medial_meniscus.quote: Normaal voorkomende menisci.

lateral_meniscus.quote: Normaal voorkomende menisci.

acl.quote: Intact ACL and PCL.

mcl.quote: Mild thickening of the proximal MCL in keeping with previous injury and healing with scarring.

medial_meniscus.quote: On a background of mucoid degeneration there is a complex tear of the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus with an associated 13 mm 16 mm x 7 mm parameniscal cyst posteriorly.

lateral_meniscus.quote: Intact lateral meniscus.

medial_oa.quote: Otherwise well-maintained tricompartmental hyaline cartilage.

lateral_oa.quote: Otherwise well-maintained tricompartmental hyaline cartilage.

pf_oa.quote: Focal high-grade chondral fissuring along the lateral femoral trochlear surface with minor underlying bone stress change.

contusion.quote: Minor bone stress changes in the posterior aspect of the medial tibial condyle however no discrete fracture.

fracture.quote: Minor bone stress changes in the posterior aspect of the medial tibial condyle however no discrete fracture.

acl.quote: The contour of anterior cruciate ligament is in a straight line but increase signal intensity inside, likely due to sprain

mcl.quote: Normal appearance of medial and lateral collateral ligaments

medial_meniscus.quote: No definite tear of medial or lateral meniscus in this study

lateral_meniscus.quote: No definite tear of medial or lateral meniscus in this study

contusion.quote: No significant bone marrow edema or active cortical destruction in distal femur, proximal tibia and fibula in this study.

fracture.quote: No significant bone marrow edema or active cortical destruction in distal femur, proximal tibia and fibula in this study.
